scenes.title: The emptiest courtyard in America
scenes.vo: This might be the emptiest courtyard in America.
Louis Kahn planned to plant trees here. His friend Luis Barragán said: no trees. Make it a facade to the sky.
So the plaza stayed empty, with one thin line of water running straight to the ocean.

label.name: The study towers
label.meta: Teak windows, angled to the sea

scenes.vo: And the scientists' studies are angled, so every one of them catches the Pacific.

caption:
The most powerful thing in this courtyard is what's missing.

Louis Kahn's Salk Institute (1965): a travertine plaza, one line of water, and the whole Pacific as the view.
